name: apexyard-status
description: Display-only ApexYard status band above the prompt: active ticket, PRs waiting for /approve-merge, reviewer lock, optional build count.

build_process_pattern.title: Build-process pattern
build_process_pattern.description: Regular expression matched against each running process command line. Matching processes count as background builds. Empty turns the build count off.

waiting_window_days.title: Waiting window (days)
waiting_window_days.description: Count a Rex-approved PR as waiting for /approve-merge only when its Rex marker is newer than this number of days.
